projectDescription: CyberOS is CyberSkill's AI-native internal operations platform — a federated set of modules covering memory, workflows, skills, HR, CRM, project management, and more — that agents and people operate together inside any organisation.
keyFeatures: Append-only, cryptographically audit-chained BRAIN memory store (Layer 1 protocol + Layer 2 semantic search)
Anthropic Agent Skills open-standard compliant skill library with 100+ author/audit skill pairs
CUO workflow engine driving tasks through a governed lifecycle with mandatory human-acceptance gates
MCP (Model Context Protocol) gateway — speak natively to any MCP-compatible agent
AI Gateway with LiteLLM, cost ledger, PII redaction, and multi-provider routing
Multi-module HR, REW, PROJ, TIME, CRM, KB, LEARN, ESOP, INV operations platform
Vietnamese-market-first: MST validation, VietQR/VnPay, hóa đơn, Decree 145 labour-law guardrails
Multi-tenant SaaS isolation (Postgres RLS, NATS subject scoping, S3 prefix ACLs)
Agent-independent: works with Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Grok, and any file-and-shell agent
npx / Claude plugin / MCP stdio / Docker install channels
publicApiSurface: python -m cyberos doctor  — verify store health
python -m cyberos export  — deterministic portable zip of the BRAIN store
npx cyberos install <repo>  — vendor CyberOS into a repository
npx cyberos update <repo>  — apply CyberOS updates
cyberos-cuo list-personas  — list active CUO personas
MCP tools: task_install, task_gates, task_status, ship_task
memory.put / memory.move / memory.delete / memory.put_if  — Layer-1 store operations
cyberos-ten provision <tenant>  — provision a new tenant (ops CLI)
services/auth REST endpoints: list_tenants, list_subjects, revoke, unrevoke, travel_admin
Skill SKILL.md frontmatter contract (name, description, invocation_modes, expects, produces)
